notes.notes:

Update #4 - "Optimizator"
Owners of slower computers may have faced some difficulties with multi touch of the keys (e.g. running + gravity change). The game has become less demanding. I guess now it might work even on a pen. 

The size of the game has been reduced from 140 MB to 37 MB

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25437187/ab61acefe7210921ebebce8d562ce9236719767a.png

Update #2 - "Fear of heights" 
We got rid of the bug that made our cat get stuck at the edge of the platform. He was just so afraid to fall down from there. :( 

Some levels have been modified.

Menu changes: 
"Restart" button was replaced with "Select Level"; 
Menu now shows the level number your're at.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25437187/0f28cdec5a9c7831ac4280d25a525976644603d0.png
Some new materials have also been added into the game client for the new levels.

We also fixed an error when the character after his death in "Infinite Inverted" mode passed into the standart mode.

Thanks: ☽ LUNATEE ☽, beartinker, Tired Tigress ːFunnyCatː

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25437187/4ca20649e2a603b25ae15ecf396ec56880ba0635.png

Update #1 - "Unreasonable inhumanity"

Hi everybody! From the moment of the game release a number of levels have been worked over due to problems some users had met with xbox360 controller. 
The very first levels have been modified - they became a little bit easier for new players (lvls 8 & 10). Thanks a lot to guys who leave messages about bugs on the game's page! You really help me in making Gravity Cat better. In less than a month the new 53 - 70 levels are going to be added for those who loves hardcore gaming. 

Special thanks to: Deathcrazy, TOG | Andremelb, bigh, Damian,  >, Markiplier, SHIMOROSHOW - you help in the game gevelopment.
